phase.name: Owner Authentication Cost / Security Reduction Proof

decision.reason: Auth0 Essentials adds the Pro roaming FIDO2 security-key MFA and required-UV path, log stream and retention, support, and operating capacity needed around exact-factor and recovery controls. Free custom-domain, basic-protection, limited-Action, one-day-log, multiple-passkey, and passkey-method-detection features are baseline; Free remains blocked because hardware-roaming-only enforcement, two physically independent credentials, safe enrollment/recovery boundaries, and exact high-risk policy are not established.

selected_credential_policy.current_limitation: Specific Auth0 support guidance says one application user can enroll only one YubiKey in the WebAuthn security-key MFA factor.

passkey_taxonomy.property: May propagate through an ecosystem account to additional devices.
Bound to one platform authenticator but not necessarily a dedicated hardware key.
Physical portable authenticator; credential remains on key and may be used from multiple endpoints.

hard_requirement_results.control: Password plus mandatory origin-bound webauthn-roaming; password alone denied.
Auth0 security-key User Verification Required with FIDO2 PIN.
One roaming key plus one physically isolated recovery code; separate recovery client synchronously verifies recovery-code and has no commerce audience/session; not the preferred two-key model.
Opaque revocable BFF session with protected cookie, rotation, bounded lifetime, CSRF defense, and logout.
max_age and auth_time plus forced webauthn-roaming Action challenge and one-use command-bound application grant.
AdminDevice and application session state remain canonical and independently revocable.
Missing, unknown, invalid, expired, revoked, unverified, or unsupported state denies.
Auth0 events feed durable canonical application audit; provider retention is not canonical.

candidates.primary_residual: One YubiKey enrollment and bearer recovery code rather than two enrolled keys; Essentials lacks provider session-management API.
Second credential, roaming hardware-key policy, exact passkey step-up, complete credential audit, and safe sole-owner recovery are not established.
The bootstrapped owner's password route is not shown removable; verifyWithPasskey conflicts with the general reverification guide; hardware-only enforcement and all-key-loss recovery remain unproved.
A third key covers R10, but Blowin' Smoke owns bootstrap, all-three-key recovery, ceremony state, abuse protection, compatibility, audit, patching, and incident response.

recovery_cases.selected_result: Use Mac plus password and key PIN; revoke iPhone AdminDevice and sessions; audit.
Use iPhone Safari plus password and NFC or USB-C key PIN; revoke Mac AdminDevice and sessions; audit.

Separate recovery client synchronously verifies offline recovery code, creates no commerce session, and enters RECOVERY_LOCKED; revoke or review old state; replace key; notify and audit; assurance temporarily downgraded.
Use Mac plus offline recovery code in containment; revoke both lost assets; replace key; notify and audit.
Use iPhone plus offline recovery code in containment; revoke both lost assets; replace key; notify and audit.
Fresh password plus roaming key PIN; known endpoint creates bounded session or unknown endpoint enters governed admission.
Key PIN remains a barrier; offline recovery containment removes and replaces key; revoke security-sensitive state; notify and audit.
Surviving endpoint plus key revokes AdminDevice and linked sessions; audit.
Same containment as R03; replace key and complete audit before ordinary access.

Selected Auth0 design has one enrolled key; offline recovery code is the independent recovery credential. If key and code are lost, no self-service recovery exists; attended provider or tenant identity proofing cannot itself bypass application reestablishment.

Password alone denied; roaming key, active actor, device, and session required.
Email alone cannot authenticate, recover, enroll a factor, or approve a device.
No SMS factor or SMS recovery exists.
Revoke local device and sessions; hardware key PIN remains required for new login.
Revoke local device and sessions; hardware key PIN remains required for new login.
Required UV denies normal use; recover, revoke, replace, notify, and audit.
Bounded revocable session; high-risk work requires fresh key UV.
Rotation, bounded lifetime, local revocation, device checks, and fresh high-risk step-up constrain replay.
SameSite plus CSRF token and origin or fetch-metadata checks; exact authorization; no unsafe GET mutation.

Ordinary change requires active device/session and fresh roaming-key UV; attended one-time bootstrap and synchronously authenticated RECOVERY_LOCKED replacement are the only no-existing-key exceptions and return no commerce payload until complete.

Weak channels denied; ordinary client accepts only webauthn-roaming; separate recovery client synchronously verifies recovery-code plus client/audience, creates no commerce session, and enters recovery lock.
Canonical AdminDevice check denies and linked sessions are invalid.
Removed factor cannot satisfy challenge; related local state contained.
Fresh forced roaming-key ceremony and one-use command-bound grant required.
No new login, step-up, factor change, or recovery; no weak fallback.
Database availability does not authorize identity; bounded existing sessions only and high-risk commands denied.
Export supported data, preserve canonical state, re-enroll WebAuthn credentials, prove cutover, then revoke old integration.
Fresh password plus key PIN; new bounded session subject to device admission.
Offline recovery code permits recovery-only containment, replacement, revocation, notification, and audit.

cost_model.hardware_correction_reason: One Auth0 application-user YubiKey rather than two; recovery code is the independent recovery credential.

critical_evidence.establishes: Free baseline includes custom domain, passkeys/passwordless, Basic Attack Protection, limited Actions and one-day logs; Essentials is $35 and adds Pro MFA, log stream and longer retention, support, and capacity.
critical_evidence.does_not_establish: Configured assurance, exact annual-prepayment total, or final invoice.

critical_evidence.establishes: Roaming FIDO security-key support and User Verification Required policy.
critical_evidence.does_not_establish: Multiple key enrollment or exact target execution result.

critical_evidence.establishes: Current specific guidance says one application user can enroll only one YubiKey in the WebAuthn security-key MFA factor.
critical_evidence.does_not_establish: Future provider behavior or resolution of general-documentation ambiguity.

critical_evidence.establishes: Auth0 supports up to 20 database passkeys per user; passkeys can synchronize; passwords can remain valid alongside them.
critical_evidence.does_not_establish: Roaming-hardware-only enforcement, two physically independent keys, approved-device identity, or safe no-password recovery.

critical_evidence.source: Detecting Passkey Usage in Auth0 Post-Login Actions — Auth0 Support
critical_evidence.establishes: A Post-Login Action can detect database-passkey use through event.authentication.methods.
critical_evidence.does_not_establish: Authenticator hardware class, attestation, approved endpoint, exact step-up, or safe recovery.

critical_evidence.source: Creating a Second Passkey for the Same User on a Different Device — Auth0 Support
critical_evidence.establishes: With local enrollment enabled, an existing passkey can support offering a second local passkey on another device; the example includes a passkey stored on a YubiKey.
critical_evidence.does_not_establish: Two roaming hardware keys, hardware-only enforcement, prevention of progressive/password enrollment bypass, or safe recovery.

critical_evidence.establishes: Actions can request webauthn-roaming and deny when the required factor is absent.
critical_evidence.does_not_establish: Successful target configuration or application command binding.

critical_evidence.establishes: max_age and auth_time freshness evidence.
critical_evidence.does_not_establish: Factor assurance without separate enforcement.

critical_evidence.establishes: Recovery code can restore access after factor loss.
critical_evidence.does_not_establish: Phishing resistance, physical custody, or application containment.

critical_evidence.establishes: Recovery uses an explicit mfa-recovery-code grant with client ID, MFA token, and recovery code and can return a replacement code.
critical_evidence.does_not_establish: Automatic commerce lock, safe target implementation, or complete replacement-key ceremony.

critical_evidence.establishes: Post-login Actions receive completed authentication methods and initiating client ID.
critical_evidence.does_not_establish: Correct recovery-client policy or application authorization.

critical_evidence.establishes: Actions can challenge recovery-code or webauthn-roaming, deny access, enroll factors, and set custom token claims.
critical_evidence.does_not_establish: Successful target Action sequence, audience isolation, or recovery completion.

critical_evidence.source: Use enrollWithAny to Enroll in Recovery Code after Another Factor — Auth0 Support
critical_evidence.establishes: Custom enrollment of another factor does not automatically issue a recovery code; a sequenced enrollWith recovery-code call is required.
critical_evidence.does_not_establish: Successful target Action sequence or completed bootstrap proof.

critical_evidence.source: Universal Login MFA Recovery Code Challenge New Code
critical_evidence.establishes: After successful recovery authentication, Universal Login displays a new recovery code and prompts the user to save it securely.
critical_evidence.does_not_establish: Application containment, physical resealing, or successful target execution.

critical_evidence.establishes: User-scoped MFA-audience tokens can list and delete authenticators with explicit scopes.
critical_evidence.does_not_establish: That recovery automatically grants required scopes or that sole-key replacement succeeds without proof.

critical_evidence.establishes: A tenant administrator can reset an application user's MFA and Auth0 Support handles tenant-admin MFA reset.
critical_evidence.does_not_establish: Safe sole-owner control-plane recovery or commerce authorization.

critical_evidence.source: Add Multi-Factor Authentication for Auth0 Dashboard Access
critical_evidence.establishes: Dashboard users can self-enroll MFA; Auth0 recommends WebAuthn factors, multiple factors, and a recovery code.
critical_evidence.does_not_establish: Exact control-plane key topology, same-key cross-RP safety, or completed recovery proof.

critical_evidence.source: Auth0 Account Locked: MFA Reset Requests — Auth0 Support
critical_evidence.establishes: Auth0 documents an identity-verified support reset process when a tenant member loses all authenticators and the recovery code.
critical_evidence.does_not_establish: Recovery completion time, exact identity-proofing outcome, or commerce authority.

critical_evidence.establishes: UV passkeys, hosted-only integration, custom-domain recommendation, and current inability to add another passkey after enrollment.
critical_evidence.does_not_establish: Roaming key policy, second credential, or safe recovery.

critical_evidence.establishes: auth_time and max_age freshness.
critical_evidence.does_not_establish: Ability to demand a passkey specifically.

critical_evidence.establishes: Passkeys require another strategy for initial signup and disabling Password does not remove it from existing users.
critical_evidence.does_not_establish: A supported way to delete the bootstrapped owner's password route or enforce passkey-only ordinary authentication.

critical_evidence.establishes: verifyWithPasskey and factor verification age exist in current Session API.
critical_evidence.does_not_establish: End-to-end production proof or command binding.

critical_evidence.establishes: Documented reverification factor list and downgrade behavior.
critical_evidence.does_not_establish: Reconciliation with the newer passkey Session API.

critical_evidence.establishes: WebAuthn ceremony and verifier requirements, credential records, UV, counters, and backup state.
critical_evidence.does_not_establish: Application sessions, recovery, audit, abuse control, device admission, or correct implementation.

critical_evidence.establishes: Maintained registration and authentication generation and verification helpers.
critical_evidence.does_not_establish: A complete identity provider or Blowin' Smoke policy implementation.

critical_evidence.establishes: Reference FIDO-only USB-C and NFC key price of $29.
critical_evidence.does_not_establish: Tax, shipping, future price, or exact owner-device test result.
